sloka: बाणौघैर्वितताः सर्वा दिशश्च प्रदिशस्तथा।सञ्छन्ना वसुधा चैव समन्तान्न प्रकाशते ।। ६.७९.२८ ।।
transliteration: bāṇaughairvitatāḥ sarvā diśaśca pradiśastathā।sañchannā vasudhā caiva samantānna prakāśate ।। 6.79.28 ।।

translations.english: All quarters were covered by the arrows in that manner all over and even the intermediate point, the earth could not be seen.
